issues.ko: 내 말 하나가 3번 칸에 있다. 이번에 도가 나왔다.
issues.en: One of my pieces is on space 3. This time, do came up.
issues.explanation: The romanized throw name "do" is also an English auxiliary verb, so "This time, do came up." and "if do comes up" in the rules can momentarily misparse. Meaning is intact; if the team wants to act, capitalize all five throw names (Do, Gae, Geol, Yut, Mo) consistently across the game rather than only this one.

issues.ko: 이번 차례에 걸과 윷이 나왔다. 두 결과를 모두 한 말에 차례로 쓴다(어느 것을 먼저 쓸지는 고를 수 있다). 각 결과로 움직임을 마칠 때마다 잡기를 따진다. 상대 말을 하나라도 잡으려면 어느 말을 어떤 순서로 움직여야 하는가?
issues.en: This turn, geol and yut came up. Both results are used on one piece, one after the other (which one to use first may be chosen). Capturing is checked each time a move with a result is finished. To capture at least one opponent's piece, which piece should be moved, and in what order?
issues.explanation: "각 결과로 움직임을 마칠 때마다" is "each time a move with each result is finished"; "a move with a result" is vaguer than the Korean but not wrong.
issues.suggested_en: This turn, geol and yut came up. Both results are used on one piece, one after the other (which one to use first may be chosen). Capturing is checked each time a move with each result is finished. To capture at least one opponent's piece, which piece should be moved, and in what order?
